desc: 一机搞定全屋安装、多档电池可选、无级变速省力安全

shots.intent: 低角度台阶承托立式整机，金属大标题一秒传递强劲动力，赢取点击

shots.intent: 六枚银质图标把品质、钻头、售后、质检一次说清，购买顾虑提前打消

shots.intent: 客厅实景加四处安装标注，让买家代入自家装修，一机多用可感知
shots.textZone: top band two-line charcoal headline; four orange label pills over the photo

shots.intent: 混凝土、金属、木作、家装四格实钻，证明一机多材质通用

shots.intent: 双机并列规格框标注，呈现多款可选，降低选择门槛
shots.textZone: header strip right label, centered headline and grey subline above the units, one label box under each unit

shots.intent: 三列电池规格卡按容量分层匹配使用场景，回应能用多久的疑虑
shots.textZone: white capacity label inside each yellow header, one charcoal use-case caption at each column bottom

shots.intent: 侧视特写变速开关配松手即停安全文案，突出省力又安全

shots.intent: 高角度夹头特写配双档标注，证明扭矩可调、操作直观
shots.textZone: left column two-line headline, grey subline and two stacked callout boxes with captions

shots.intent: 蓝色能量光束抽象图解电机动力与低噪耐用，承接首图力量主张
红亏绿满双电池对比，直观传达大容量长续航的利益
shots.textZone: one label under each battery icon

shots.intent: 圆角参数卡整机标注加规格表，透明呈现可见参数收尾建立信任
shots.textZone: card top bold headline; four part labels around the product; spec table with golden-yellow row bars and short charcoal value fields for visible attributes

style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal #26282C sections and pure white #FFFFFF sections, one neutral mid-grey #6A6D72 feature panel, rounded white info cards on dark, small golden-yellow divider bars
style.iconSystem: metallic-silver filled feature icons on the grey panel, small orange #ED7B2E annotation dots with thin leader lines, rounded rectangle label pills; consistent across the set
style.lightingSystem: neutral directional studio key at 5600K from the upper left, controlled metal speculars, soft contact shadows; dark sections with gentle falloff, light sections bright and even
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial home-improvement power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #26282C, pure white #FFFFFF, neutral mid-grey panel #6A6D72 and one golden-yellow accent #F2A93B, with one cool blue #3FA9F5 reserved exclusively for the motor energy-beam graphic; neutral directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, silver-white #D9DBDE headlines on dark sections and charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light sections with short golden-yellow divider bars; consistent metallic-silver filled feature icons, small orange #ED7B2E annotation dots with thin leader lines and rounded rectangle label pills; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale, battery foot always grounded; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins inside info panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; battery foot always grounded with contact shadow; no floating product; annotations never cover the product
style.surfaceSystem: brushed-graphite step podiums and wall panels; warm wood floors and bright home interiors inside scene photos; matte white tiles for application grids
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; silver-white #D9DBDE headlines on dark sections, charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light sections with grey sublines and short golden-yellow #F2A93B divider bars
